subject: Pilot wrap: performance uplift & cost delta — quick quote + 20-min reference?
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Liu <emma@fastretro.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot wrap: performance uplift & cost delta — quick quote + 20-min reference?

Hi Emma,

Thanks again for running the pilot with us — really appreciated the collaboration. Quick recap from our side: across the test traffic we saw median generation latency drop from ~420ms to ~160ms (for the 512-token baseline) and overall inference spend down ~38% after enabling prefix caching + optimized batching. I attached the two-pager summary and a chart that highlights the cost delta by request class.

Would you be open to two small asks?
- A short (20-minute) reference call next week where a product person from your team can speak to speed improvements and the integration lift.
- A one-sentence quote we can use on a customer slide (we’ll send the exact attribution and preview before publishing).

If yes, any of these windows work for us: Tue 8/10 10:00–11:00 PT, Wed 8/11 09:00–11:30 PT, or Thu 8/12 14:00–16:00 PT. If those don’t work, propose a couple of options and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: pilot_metrics_summary.pdf (2 pages), cost-savings-chart.png

Thanks — we’d love to highlight FastRetro as an early enterprise partner.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0119

From: Emma Liu <emma@fastretro.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-09T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap: performance uplift & cost delta — quick quote + 20-min reference?

Marissa — thanks for the note and the clear recap. The numbers look right to what we observed on our end; the latency improvement was immediately noticeable in our QA runs. Happy to do a short call next week. Wed 8/11 09:30–10:00 PT works best for our product director (she’s available then).

We’re also comfortable providing a short quote. Internal marketing will want to sign off but quick draft: "Redwood cut our inference latency substantially while reducing costs — integration was straightforward and the dev experience was excellent." I can confirm exact wording on the call or send final approval via email.

—Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Product, FastRetro
emma@fastretro.io
